prose: SK Telecom unit SK Hyper is in talks with big tech firms and financial investors to fund an envisioned 15GW of data-center capacity in South Korea by 2035, with the first 5GW expected to cost $350 billion, Bloomberg reports - one of the largest single-country AI infrastructure ambitions yet disclosed.
highlights: SK Hyper in talks to finance 15GW of South Korean data-center capacity by 2035 (Bloomberg)
Talks involve big tech firms and financial investors
